system_overview: This specification is the TLC model-checking configuration module for the Non-Blocking Atomic Commitment Protocol (ACP-NB). It extends the base ACP-NB specification to make it ready for verification with the TLC model checker, adding symmetry support for participant permutations and providing an alternative formulation of the irrevocability property that TLC can check more efficiently.
actors_and_components: The same actors as the base ACP-NB specification: a set of participants implementing reliable broadcast through forwarding, and a single coordinator. This module adds no new actors but configures the system for model checking.
state_variables: The same state variables as the base ACP-NB specification (including participant forwarding tables). No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Identical to the base ACP-NB specification.
actions: All actions are inherited from the base ACP-NB specification. No new actions are defined.
safety_properties: This module provides an alternative formulation of the irrevocability property (AC4) designed for efficient TLC checking: expressed as a next-state relation requiring that commit and abort decisions are stable across transitions. All other safety properties (AC1, AC2, AC3) are inherited.
liveness_properties: Inherited from the base ACP-NB specification, including AC5 (non-blocking termination) and the liveness component of AC3.
model_bounds: The participant set is instantiated as a finite set of model values (typically 2 to 4 participants). The module defines symmetry over participant permutations to reduce state space.
additional_assumptions: This module extends the ACP-NB module and the TLC module. Symmetry reduction is available through participant permutations.
